print('Invalid revenue entries after cleaning:', invalid_count_after_clean)
print('Duplicate rows after cleaning:', duplicates_clean)

print('Unique customer segments:', sales_df_clean['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check status distribution
print('\nStatus distribution:')
print(sales_df_clean['status'].value_counts())

revenue_positive_converted_zero = sales_df_clean[(sales_df_clean['revenue'] > 0) & (sales_df_clean['converted'] == 0)]
